response.rationale: Both answers are valid, but the card overstates a country-specific contrast. Indonesian uses waktu for general time, while masa is also valid, especially for a period or era. Malaysian Malay uses masa for general time, but waktu is likewise standard and common. This is not a strict false-friend pair; the learner needs an explicit usage/preference caveat.
